description: Replace mod-based sharding with a consistent-hash ring (virtual nodes) so removing one node only remaps that node's own keys
prompts: ring.js's HashRing picks a node with `hashInt(key) % nodes.length` - removing or adding any node reshuffles almost every key. Implement a real consistent-hash ring with virtual nodes: the constructor takes (nodes, replicas = 100) and places `replicas` virtual points per physical node around a ring, hashed via node's crypto.createHash('md5') over `${node}:${i}` for each virtual point (do NOT use a plain string hashCode - it must be a real, well-distributed hash). getNode(key) hashes the key onto the ring and returns the node owning the next virtual point clockwise (wrapping around). addNode(node) and removeNode(node) update the ring in place.
name: add_js_consistent_hash_ring
